steps.title: What is a skewer?
steps.body: A skewer attacks a valuable piece so it has to move. Then you capture the piece behind it. It works like a pin in reverse.

steps.title: The skewer
steps.body: The rook checks along the a-file. The king steps aside, and the rook slides up the file to take the rook on a8.

steps.title: Start the skewer
steps.body: Give check with the rook to start the skewer.
steps.hint: Move the rook onto the a-file, the same file as the king.
steps.success: Check! Now the king has to move out of the way.

steps.question: What happens to the piece behind in a skewer?
steps.explanation: Once the front piece moves, the piece behind is exposed to attack.
